nodes.question: How do healthy eating behaviours at casual dining restaurants align with the extended theory of planned behaviour?
nodes.answer: Healthy eating behaviours at casual dining restaurants can align with the extended theory of planned behaviour by considering factors such as attitudes, subjective norms, perceived behavioural control, and personal values in influencing individuals' food choices in restaurant settings.
